summary.title: Online Student Portal Threat Model
summary.description: A STRIDE threat model for an Internet-accessible university student portal used by students, lecturers and administrators.

diagrams.title: Student Portal DFD

threats.title: Stolen Lecturer Account
threats.description: An attacker impersonates a lecturer using stolen credentials.
threats.mitigation: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA), enforce strong password policies, store passwords using secure hashing, enable account lockout after repeated failed login attempts, and monitor suspicious login activities.

threats.title: Unauthorized Modification of Marks
threats.description: An attacker or unauthorized user modifies student examination marks without permission.

threats.title: Exposure of Student Results
threats.description: Unauthorized users gain access to confidential student examination results or personal information.
threats.mitigation: Encrypt data in transit using HTTPS, enforce access control so users can view only their own records, secure database access, and regularly review user permissions.
